name: TaiAi
description: Connect Codex to a scoped TaiAi instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped TaiAi tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to TaiAi through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so TaiAi Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use TaiAi only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
